goal: Prevent peers from stalling node message processing when reconsidering orphan transactions
Reduce peer latency by stopping one peer from monopolizing validation turns
agreement: Broad support with multiple approvals and no blocking objections
Verified by testing peer latency trade-offs and test suite behavior (fametrano)
Supports simplifying the orphan reconsideration flow (ViniciusCestarii)
Minor open suggestion for an extra test sanity check (furszy)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it mitigates peer starvation and strengthens DoS resilience in message processing
Evaluating repeatedly failing orphans in one turn holds locks and delays messages from other peers
